problems: The blind guess ('irregular closed outline with a small loop, no clear object') did not recognise a tooth. The silhouette reads as a crown with two roots, but the crown is too flat and wide and the roots are not separated clearly enough to read as a molar.
The silhouette is upright: the crown is at the top and the roots point down, which is correct.

Key stars sit on the right parts overall: top-left cusp (153,111), top-right cusp (416,137), left crown corner (84,162), enamel point (109,265), left root tip (117,381), right root tip (447,356), bottom root tip (337,468), and pulp chamber (255,237) all look plausible.
The 'middle of the top edge' star (286,143) and label sit on the blue outline, but its label is overlapped by the blue line.
The 'pulp chamber, the living nerve' label collides with the pulp-chamber star and the blue loop. The 'right edge of the pulp chamber' label is clipped by the loop.
The 'bottom root tip' label is overprinted by an unlabelled stray star at about (345,453).
Unlabelled stray stars at about (392,147), (272,261), (88,328) and (97,363) sit outside the intended key-star set and add visual noise.

The gold lines mostly trace the blue silhouette, but the gold polygon is a near-copy of the outline. The blue silhouette is the real contour, so this is acceptable but the gold lines sit too close to it to read as separate structure.
The root canal line (272,320 to 337,468) runs down the right side of the pulp loop but it is not clearly distinguished from the outline, so the 'root canal running down the right root' reads weakly.
output.advice: Redraw so the tooth is unmistakable. Make the crown wider than the roots and round the top corners more, so it reads as a molar. Keep the two roots separated by a clear gap and make them taper to root tips at left (117,381), right (447,356) and bottom (337,468). Keep the key star positions for the crown cusps (153,111), (416,137), (286,143), the crown left corner (84,162), and the enamel point (109,265). Move the pulp chamber star (255,237) and the right pulp edge (337,262) so the pulp loop sits centred in the crown, and put the root canal (272,320 to 337,468) down the middle of the right root. Remove the stray unlabelled stars at (392,147), (272,261), (88,328), (97,363), and (345,453). Move labels off the outline and away from stars so none collide, especially 'middle of the top edge', 'pulp chamber', and 'bottom root tip'.
